notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Kept Immolate maintenance, the Shadowburn execute, and Life Tap; moved the Shadowburn execute condition from a fixed remaining-fight-time check to isExecutePhase(E20), matching the target-health idiom used elsewhere in this lane rather than only firing at the very end of a fight. Amplify Curse and Demonic Sacrifice were dropped: Destruction does not talent into either. Immolate is now cast at prepull so the DoT is already ticking when the fight opens. Conflagrate and Incinerate (412758) are Forever's own Destruction talents and both require Immolate on the target. Fix round 1: Incinerate is not registered anywhere in sim/warlock (it exists only in the talent-tree metadata table, no spell file, no ActionID) -- it was this file's only unconditional filler with nothing beneath it, so once Immolate was up and Conflagrate on cooldown this rotation had nothing left to cast. The Incinerate line is kept (it is the guide's own placement of Destruction's signature filler) and Shadow Bolt (25307, corrected to the build's current top rank 10 from the shared preset's stale rank 9) is added beneath it as the engine-castable Era filler, so the rotation still deals damage today and upgrades itself once Incinerate lands. An earlier draft of these notes claimed the Shadow Bolt rank fix had already been made in this file; it had not -- Shadow Bolt had been removed outright rather than rank-corrected, which this fix round corrects by actually adding it. Fix round 3: Conflagrate was cast as 1293817, the id the Forever talent-tree metadata table carries; sim/warlock/conflagrate.go registers the vanilla ids 17962/18930/18931/18932 instead, and 1293817 is cast by nothing. All four vanilla ids are in this build's spellconst, so the line now names 18932 (spellconst rank 6), the highest one registered at level 60 -- not declared inert, since it is a real, engine-castable Conflagrate, just talent-gated like Shadowburn beneath it. Every rank named here (other than the flagged inert Incinerate line) is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program fix round (2026-09-28): Incinerate is no longer inert -- sim/warlock/incinerate.go registers it for real now, talent- and level-gated (see the priority list's own updated note on that line) -- and Shadow Bolt below it is now gated on spellIsKnown(412758) so it yields once Incinerate is taken instead of sitting permanently unreachable beneath an unconditional Incinerate cast.

expected_idle.reason: Shadow Bolt is gated `not spellIsKnown(412758)`, the pre-Incinerate filler (see the priority list's own note on this line and on Incinerate above it). At every level this ladder's own zero_casts check flags it (40+), Incinerate is already known and correctly claims the filler slot instead -- the ladder's own cast sets confirm 412758/1293812/1293813 firing at those levels. The fallback yielding as designed, not a defect, the same shape as rogue-subtlety's Sinister Strike/Hemorrhage line.

Warcraft Tavern: Classic Destruction Warlock DPS rotation

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Immolate is the DoT both Conflagrate and Incinerate need on the target, so it is refreshed the moment it falls off.

Conflagrate consumes part of Immolate's remaining damage as instant burst; only worth casting while Immolate is up. Fix round 3: cast as 18932 rank 6, the highest of the vanilla ids sim/warlock/conflagrate.go actually registers (17962/18930/18931/18932), not 1293817 -- the id the Forever talent-tree metadata table carries, which nothing in sim/warlock ever casts. Talent-gated (sim/warlock/conflagrate.go's registerConflagrateSpell returns immediately without warlock.Talents.Conflagrate), so it stays unresolved under this build's no-talent smoke run the same way Shadowburn below does.
Shadowburn as the execute finisher below 20 percent target health.

Rotation-accuracy program fix round: sim/warlock/incinerate.go now registers Incinerate for real (talent-gated on warlock.Talents.Incinerate, level-gated 40/50/60 per rank) -- the 'inert, no spell registration' note above this line described an earlier engine state and is stale; the ladder's own cast sets show 412758/1293812/1293813 actually firing at level 38+ once the truncated build's talent walk reaches Incinerate's row. Destruction's signature filler, dealing bonus damage while Immolate is active.

Shadow Bolt as the pre-Incinerate filler: this line always sat directly beneath Incinerate's unconditional cast, so once Incinerate stopped being inert (see above) it claimed every GCD Shadow Bolt used to get, leaving Shadow Bolt's own authored id a zero_casts ladder violation at every level from 40 on -- not a bug in Shadow Bolt, just an unreachable line now that the ability above it always wins. Gated on spellIsKnown(412758) so Shadow Bolt is the filler while Incinerate's talent has not been taken (or its level-40 row not yet reached) and correctly yields once it has, the same not-spellIsKnown shape rogue-subtlety's Sinister Strike/Hemorrhage line and mage-fire's Improved Scorch/Fireball line use.
